name: ARA2505
title: No such branch session
summary: No branch session has this ID.
html:
No branch session has this ID.

#Common causes

  • A typo in the ID, or the branch belongs to another project or host.

#Fixes

  • List branch sessions with branch.list and use one of their IDs.

  • Code: ARA2505

  • Constant: collab::BRANCH_NOT_FOUND

  • Reported by: ara-collab
